name: post-quantum-auditors
description: Domain auditors for post-quantum and advanced encryption: lattice-based schemes (LWE/RLWE), fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), standardized post-quantum KEMs (ML-KEM/FIPS 203), and post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA/FIPS 204, SLH-DSA/FIPS 205, FN-DSA/Falcon, XMSS/LMS per SP 800-208).
